dedupe_keys.name: a data driven approach of layout evaluation for electric vehicle charging infrastructure using agent based simulation and gis

description: Yue Zhang published an agent-based model for evaluating electric-vehicle charging layouts in Shenzhen, China. The model represents electric taxi driving and charging behaviour within a GIS road network, using GPS-derived spatial and temporal patterns and travel speeds over 24 hours. It compares charging-station layouts through user time satisfaction and differences in station workloads. The source describes a Pareto-based layout search and sensitivity analysis. Coverage is the Shenzhen case; transferable calibration and positional accuracy are not established. Simulation uses include charging-capacity planning and agent-based assessment of infrastructure locations. Caveats: the reported calibration and evaluation claims were not independently reproduced. Release 1.0.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists Repast Simphony. The release metadata states no licence, so reuse terms remain unresolved. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
